########################################
#
# Script contains analyses to determine a filter strategy for 
# downstream spAIRR analysis:
# 'Base': all reads, 'F1': consensus count > 1, 'F2': consenus count > 2
# 'F3': consensus count > 3.
#
# Analyses are performed on representable datasets from Visium V1 (S1_ONT_Q17)
#
# Analysis include heavy-light chain UMI count per SPBC correlation across filter strategies.
# Spatial distribution showing number of distinct UMIs per spatial spot across filter strategies.
# Spatial distribution of representable light chain clone across filter strategies
# Correlation of number of UMIs per SPBC and total number of reads per SPBC across filter strategies
# Number of unique CDR3 nucleotide sequences present in < 3 SPBCs vs >= SPBCs
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. 5 and S4
#
########################################

```{r}
nano_df <- rbind(rbind(nano_1_bcr %>% mutate(type = "BCR"), 
                       nano_1_tcr %>% mutate(type = "TCR")) %>% mutate(data = "S1_ONT_Q17"),
                 rbind(nano_2_bcr %>% mutate(type = "BCR"), 
                       nano_2_tcr %>% mutate(type = "TCR")) %>% mutate(data = "S2_ONT_Q17"),
                 rbind(nano_3_bcr %>% mutate(type = "BCR"), 
                       nano_3_tcr %>% mutate(type = "TCR")) %>% mutate(data = "S3_ONT_Q17")) %>%
          mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
                      start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
               filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction)) %>%
               filter(!grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
```

## correlation of chain expression
```{r}
chain_correlation <- function(df, tcr_or_bcr) {
  # if bcr combine K+L
  if(tcr_or_bcr == "BCR") {
    res <- df %>%
      filter(type == "BCR") %>%
      select(spbc, n_keep, data, locus, umi) %>%
      group_by(spbc, data, locus) %>%
      summarize(cnt_umi_spbc = n_distinct(umi)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = locus, values_from = cnt_umi_spbc, values_fill = 0) %>%
      mutate(light = IGK + IGL)
  }
  else if(tcr_or_bcr == "TCR") {
    res <- df %>%
      filter(type == "TCR") %>%
      select(spbc, n_keep, data, locus, umi) %>%
      group_by(spbc, data, locus) %>%
      summarize(cnt_umi_spbc = n_distinct(umi)) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = locus, values_from = cnt_umi_spbc, values_fill = 0)
  }
  res
}
```

# Correlation summary
--------------
S4b
--------------

```{r}
corr_igexp_plt <- rbind(base_bcr_cor_df, f1_bcr_cor_df, f2_bcr_cor_df, f3_bcr_cor_df) %>%
  dplyr::filter(data == "S1_ONT_Q17") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = IGH, y = light)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(linewidth = 0.35) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~filt, ncol = 4) +
  xlab("Heavy chain (IGH)\nUMI count per SPBC (log10)") +
  ylab("Light chain (IGK + IGL)\nUMI count per SPBC\n(log10)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
```

```{r, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=1.5}
ps4_b <- corr_igexp_plt + patchwork::plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=5, 5, 5, 5)))
ps4_b
```

# Spatial coordinates
--------------
5b
--------------

```{r}
sp_bc <- read.csv("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/2_initial_submission/main/panel5/scripts/katharina_scripts/barcode_coordinates.csv", sep = "\t", header = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(spbc = V1, x = V2, y = V3)
```

```{r}
umi_dist_plt <- full_join(rbind(base_spbc_df, f1_spbc_df, f2_spbc_df, f3_spbc_df), sp_bc, by = "spbc") %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  filter(data == "S1_ONT_Q17") %>%
  filter(locus %in% c("IGH", "IGK", "IGL")) %>%
  mutate(nb_umis_bin = case_when(
      nb_umis <= 1  ~ "1",
      nb_umis <= 5  ~ "2-5",
      nb_umis <= 10 ~ "6-10",
      nb_umis <= 50 ~ "11-50",
      nb_umis < 100 ~ "51-99",
      nb_umis >= 100 ~ "≥100"),
    nb_umis_bin = factor(nb_umis_bin, levels = c("≥100", "51-99", "11-50", "6-10", "2-5", "1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = nb_umis_bin)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(locus ~ filt) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "1"     = "gray65",
      "2-5"   = "#2f5e8f",
      "6-10"  = "#1b9e77",
      "11-50" = "#bf8630",
      "51-99" = "#d95f02",
      "≥100"  = "red3"),
    drop = FALSE, name = "  Number of\nDistinct UMIs") +
  labs(x = "x-coordinate", y = "y-coordinate") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    #panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l=-4),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1)))
```

# Look at clone recovery
--------------
5c
--------------

Representative IGK clone spatial distribution

```{r}
clone_pick_df2 <- rbind(
  nano_df %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbc) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "base"),

  nano_df_f1 %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbc) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "F1"),

  nano_df_f2 %>%
    mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbc) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "F2"),

  nano_df_f3 %>%
   mutate(clone_id = paste(v_call, j_call, junction, sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(clone_id, spbc) %>%
    mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>%
    mutate(filt = "F3")) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("x", "y"))) %>%
  filter(v_call == "IGKV1-13*02,IGKV1D-13*01,IGKV1D-13*02",
    j_call == "IGKJ4*01",
    junction == "TGTCAACAGTTTAATACTTACCCTCACGCGCTCACTTTC") %>%
  full_join(sp_bc, by = "spbc") %>%
  group_by(filt, spbc, x, y, data) %>%
  summarise(n_umi = n_distinct(umi),
    sum_reads = sum(n_keep),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
clone_subtitle <- paste(
  "IGKV1-13*02,IGKV1D-13*01,IGKV1D-13*02 | IGKJ4*01 |",
  "TGTCAACAGTTTAATACTTACCCTCACGCGCTCACTTTC")


l_clone_ex <- clone_pick_df2 %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(n_umi_bin = case_when(
      n_umi <= 1  ~ "1",
      n_umi <= 2  ~ "2",
      n_umi <= 3  ~ "3",
      n_umi <= 4  ~ "4",
      n_umi < 10  ~ "5-9",
      n_umi >= 10 ~ "≥10"),
    n_umi_bin = factor(n_umi_bin, levels = c("≥10", "5-9", "4", "3", "2", "1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = n_umi_bin)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(data ~ filt) +
  facet_grid(data ~ filt, labeller = labeller(data = c("S1_ONT_Q17" = "S1_ONT_Q17\nVisium V1"))) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "1"   = "gray80",
      "2"   = "#2f5e8f",
      "3"   = "#1b9e77",
      "4"   = "#bf8630",
      "5-9" = "#d95f02",
      "≥10" = "red3"),
    drop = FALSE, name = "  Number of\nDistinct UMIs") +
  labs(x = "x-coordinate", y = "y-coordinate", subtitle = paste("Clonotype:", clone_subtitle)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -4),
    legend.margin = margin(t=-4),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5, color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1), nrow=1)) 

```

```{r}
clone_spbc_df <- rbind(nano_df  %>%
  mutate(clone_id = junction) %>%
  group_by(clone_id, spbc) %>%
  mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>% mutate(filt = "base"),
                nano_df_f1  %>%
  mutate(clone_id = junction) %>%
  group_by(clone_id, spbc) %>%
  mutate(n_seqs_in_clone_spbc = n()) %>% mutate(filt = "F1"),
                nano_df_f2 %>% mutate(filt = "F2") %>%
  mutate(clone_id = junction),
                nano_df_f3 %>% mutate(filt = "F3")) %>%
  mutate(clone_id = junction) %>%
  group_by(clone_id, locus, data, filt) %>%
  summarize(n_spbc_in_clone = n_distinct(spbc), n_umi_in_clone = n_distinct(umi), max_n_cons_in_clone = max(n_keep))
```

```{r}
clone_spbc_filt_bar <- clone_spbc_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(data == "S1_ONT_Q17" & filt != "base") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(multi_SPBC = n_spbc_in_clone > 2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = filt, fill = multi_SPBC)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~ locus, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#d95f02ff", "FALSE" = "grey"), name = "SPBCs per CDR3", labels = c("FALSE" = "<3 SPBCs", "TRUE" = "≥3 SPBCs")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of clones") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l = -4),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
```

------ table 3

```{r}
table3 <- bind_rows(
  base = nano_df, F1 = nano_df_f1, F2 = nano_df_f2, F3 = nano_df_f3,
  .id = "filter_strategy") %>%
  filter(data == "S1_ONT_Q17") %>%
  group_by(filter_strategy, locus) %>%
  summarise(umi_spbc_groups = n(), spatial_barcodes = n_distinct(spbc),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(umi_spbc_groups, spatial_barcodes),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(filter_strategy = factor(filter_strategy, levels = c("base", "F1", "F2", "F3")),
         metric = factor(metric, levels = c("umi_spbc_groups", "spatial_barcodes"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = locus, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  select(metric, filter_strategy, IGH, IGK, IGL, TRA, TRB) %>%
  arrange(metric, filter_strategy)

table3
```
